title: Caveman
statementMd:
Monocarp drew an undirected graph with 𝑛n vertices and 𝑚m edges. He wants to color each vertex red or blue so that every vertex has at least one neighbor of the opposite color. He needs to calculate the number of colorings that suit him.

Monocarp is a caveman: he knows only the numbers 11, 22, and "many" (any number greater than 22). He does not know about zero, so if there are no valid colorings, his brain melts.

Help Monocarp count the valid colorings in his language. Two colorings are considered different if at least one vertex has a different color in them.

## Input

The first line contains an integer 𝑡t (1≤𝑡≤1041≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains two integers 𝑛n and 𝑚m (3≤𝑛≤3⋅1053≤n≤3⋅105; 0≤𝑚≤min(𝑛(𝑛−1)2,3⋅105)0≤m≤min(n(n−1)2,3⋅105)) — the number of vertices and edges.

Each of the next 𝑚m lines contains two integers 𝑢𝑖ui and 𝑣𝑖vi (1≤𝑢𝑖,𝑣𝑖≤𝑛1≤ui,vi≤n) — the numbers of the vertices connected by the 𝑖i-th edge. The graph has no self-loops or multiple edges.

Additional constraints on the input:

- the sum of 𝑛n over all test cases does not exceed 3⋅1053⋅105; also the sum of 𝑚m over all test cases does not exceed 3⋅1053⋅105.

## Output

For each test case, print on a separate line:

- `1` or `2`, if the number of valid colorings is equal to 11 or 22 respectively;
- `Many`, if the number of valid colorings is greater than two;
- `Brain Melt`, if there are no valid colorings.
statementZhMd:
Monocarp 画了一个有 $n$ 个顶点和 $m$ 条边的无向图。他想把每个顶点染成红色或蓝色，使得每个顶点都至少有一个颜色与之相反的邻居。他需要计算满足条件的染色方案数。

Monocarp 是一个穴居人：他只认识数字 1、2 和“很多”（任何大于 2 的数）。他不知道零的存在，因此如果没有合法的染色方案，他的大脑就会融化。

请帮助 Monocarp 用他的语言数出合法染色方案的数量。如果两种染色方案中至少有一个顶点的颜色不同，则认为这两种染色方案不同。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$3 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$；$0 \le m \le \min\left(\frac{n(n-1)}{2}, 3 \cdot 10^5\right)$）——分别表示顶点数和边数。

接下来的 $m$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $u_i$ 和 $v_i$（$1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$）——表示第 $i$ 条边所连接的两个顶点的编号。图中没有自环或重边。

输入的额外约束：

- 所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $3 \cdot 10^5$；同样，所有测试用例的 $m$ 之和不超过 $3 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，单独输出一行：

- `1` 或 `2`，如果合法染色方案数等于 $1$ 或 $2$；
- `Many`，如果合法染色方案数大于 $2$；
- `Brain Melt`，如果不存在合法的染色方案。
